title: Automated differentiation for parkinsonism using clinical structural MRI: A multicenter study
zh_title: 临床结构 MRI 自动鉴别帕金森综合征：多中心研究
summary: 基于 969 人多中心队列构建 T1 结构 MRI 机器学习模型区分健康对照、帕金森病与多系统萎缩，并在外部队列验证。
key_points: 多中心 969 人，采用发现-验证-转化框架
单模态 T1-Top20 模型多分类 AUROC 0.93
外部研究级队列 PD vs MSA 合并 AUROC 0.88
reason: 同行评审多中心研究，含独立外部队列验证，属重要档
abstract: Multimodal research-grade magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans show potential for differentiating Parkinson’s disease (PD) from multiple system atrophy (MSA), but clinical translation is limited by cost, acquisition time, and processing burden. Here, we developed a T1-weighted structural MRI-based machine learning model to differentiate Parkinsonism and generalized it to routine anisotropic 2D clinical MRI. Using a multicenter cohort of 969 participants, we employed a hierarchical discovery–verification–translation framework. While a multimodal benchmark model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.98, our streamlined unimodal T1-Top20 model achieved an AUROC of 0.93 for multiclass discrimination (healthy controls, PD, MSA). For PD vs MSA, the frozen T1-Top20 model achieved a pooled AUROC of 0.88 in the external research-grade cohort ( n = 227) and identified 19 of 25 who phenoconverted from idiopathic rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder (iRBD) to PD. Importantly, the generalized model achieved a pooled AUROC of 0.84 in the clinical-MRI cohort (2D T1, n = 303), supporting its potential for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: 多模态研究级磁共振成像（MRI）扫描显示出区分帕金森病（PD）与多系统萎缩（MSA）的潜力，但临床转化受成本、采集时间和处理负担限制。在此，我们开发了一种基于 T1 加权结构 MRI 的机器学习模型来区分帕金森综合征，并将其推广到常规各向异性 2D 临床 MRI。使用包含 969 名参与者的多中心队列，我们采用了分层发现—验证—转化框架。虽然多模态基准模型达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.98，我们简化的单模态 T1-Top20 模型在多分类判别（健康对照、PD、MSA）中达到 AUROC 0.93。对于 PD 与 MSA，冻结的 T1-Top20 模型在外部研究级队列（n = 227）中达到汇总 AUROC 0.88，并识别出 25 名从特发性快速眼动睡眠行为障碍（iRBD）表型转化为 PD 的参与者中的 19 名。重要的是，推广后的模型在临床 MRI 队列（2D T1，n = 303）中达到汇总 AUROC 0.84，支持其临床转化潜力。

title: A multi-stage validation framework for trustworthy large-scale clinical information extraction using large language models
zh_title: LLM 大规模临床信息抽取的多阶段可信验证框架
summary: 提出结合提示校准、规则过滤、语义接地、裁判LLM与预测效度的弱监督验证框架，用于91万余份病历的成瘾诊断抽取。
key_points: 多阶段验证框架，减少对密集人工标注的依赖
覆盖11类物质使用障碍诊断抽取任务
纳入专家复核与预测效度分析以量化不确定性
reason: 同行评审，91万份病历大样本并给出可复用验证框架，属重要档。
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for extracting clinically meaningful information from unstructured health records, yet real-world deployment is constrained by limited scalable, trustworthy validation approaches. Conventional evaluation relies on annotation-intensive reference standards and incomplete structured data, limiting population-scale use. We propose a multi-stage validation framework for LLM-based clinical information extraction that enables rigorous assessment under weak supervision by integrating complementary validation strategies. The framework combines prompt calibration, rule-based filtering, semantic grounding, judge-LLM evaluation, expert review, and predictive validity analysis to quantify uncertainty without exhaustive manual annotation. We applied this framework to extract substance use disorder (SUD) diagnoses across 11 substance categories from 919,783 clinical notes. Rule-based filtering and semantic grounding removed 14.59% of LLM-positive extractions that were unsupported or structurally implausible. For high-uncertainty cases, the judge LLM showed substantial agreement with subject matter expert. Using judge evaluations as references, the primary LLM achieved an F1 score of 0.80. LLM-extracted SUD diagnoses predicted subsequent engagement in SUD specialty care more accurately than structured-data baselines. By unifying complementary validation strategies, this work presents a generalizable human-in-the-loop framework for establishing the trustworthiness of LLM-based clinical information extraction at scale while minimizing the need for exhaustive manual annotation.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）在从非结构化健康记录中提取具有临床意义的信息方面显示出前景，但真实世界部署受到缺乏可扩展、可信验证方法的限制。传统评估依赖于标注密集型参考标准和不完整的结构化数据，限制了人群规模的应用。我们提出一个用于基于LLM的临床信息提取的多阶段验证框架，该框架通过整合互补的验证策略，能够在弱监督下进行严格评估。该框架结合提示校准、基于规则的过滤、语义接地、评判LLM（judge-LLM）评估、专家审阅和预测效度分析，以在无需详尽人工标注的情况下量化不确定性。我们将该框架应用于从919,783份临床记录中提取11类物质使用障碍（substance use disorder, SUD）诊断。基于规则的过滤和语义接地去除了14.59%的LLM阳性提取结果，这些结果缺乏支持或结构上不合理。对于高不确定性病例，评判LLM与主题专家显示出高度一致性。以评判评估作为参考，主要LLM达到0.80的F1分数。LLM提取的SUD诊断比结构化数据基线更准确地预测了后续参与SUD专科护理。通过统一互补的验证策略，这项工作提出了一个可推广的人在环框架，用于在大规模上建立基于LLM的临床信息提取的可信度，同时尽量减少对详尽人工标注的需求。

title: GWDRO-Lung: Gromov–Wasserstein distributionally robust learning for calibrated pulmonary nodule malignancy prediction across imaging cohorts
zh_title: GWDRO-Lung：跨影像队列校准的肺结节恶性预测
summary: 提出基于Gromov-Wasserstein分布鲁棒学习的胸部CT框架，在跨扫描仪、协议与人群的队列间保持肺结节恶性风险预测的准确性与校准。
key_points: 用采集元数据编码器将队列表示为原型关系矩阵
以Gromov-Wasserstein重心对齐队列几何结构
在LIDC-IDRI的1842个结节、按采集分组的队列上开发
reason: 方法有新意且关注跨队列校准，但基于同一公开数据集分组，证据有限
abstract: Low-dose chest computed tomography (CT) screening detects pulmonary nodules whose malignancy risk must be triaged, yet deep-learning risk models often lose both accuracy and calibration when transferred to a different scanner, protocol, or population. We developed GWDRO-Lung, a chest CT framework that treats cross-cohort transfer as a coupled problem of structural mismatch, distributional instability, and calibration. A weight-shared three-dimensional encoder with embedded acquisition metadata summarizes each cohort as a relation matrix over learned prototypes; cohort geometries are aligned to a shared Gromov–Wasserstein barycenter; and a distributionally robust, calibration-aware risk head estimates malignancy, with the residual alignment error setting a cohort-specific robustness radius. The model was developed on 1842 pulmonary nodules from LIDC-IDRI, organized into three acquisition-defined cohorts, and validated externally on 618 nodules from the independent LNDb cohort, with leave-one-cohort-out, protocol-shift, size-stratified, and decision-curve analyses. Relative to the strongest recent imaging baseline, external area under the receiver operating characteristic curve improved from 0.857 to 0.878, external expected calibration error fell from 0.106 to 0.066, worst-cohort AUC rose from 0.829 to 0.851, and net benefit was higher across triage-relevant thresholds. Prospective, pathology-confirmed validation is required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 低剂量胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）筛查可检出肺结节，其恶性风险必须进行分诊，然而深度学习风险模型在转移到不同扫描仪、方案或人群时往往同时丧失准确性和校准性。我们开发了GWDRO-Lung，这是一个胸部CT框架，将跨队列迁移视为结构不匹配、分布不稳定和校准的耦合问题。一个带有嵌入式采集元数据的权重共享三维编码器将每个队列概括为学习到的原型上的关系矩阵；队列几何形状对齐到共享的Gromov–Wasserstein重心；一个分布稳健、校准感知的风险头估计恶性程度，并由残余对齐误差设定队列特异性稳健性半径。该模型在来自LIDC-IDRI的1842个肺结节上开发，这些结节被组织为三个由采集定义的队列，并在独立的LNDb队列的618个结节上进行外部验证，采用留一队列、方案偏移、按大小分层和决策曲线分析。相对于近期最强的影像基线，外部受试者工作特征曲线下面积从0.857提高到0.878，外部期望校准误差从0.106降至0.066，最差队列AUC从0.829升至0.851，并且在分诊相关阈值上净获益更高。临床使用前需要进行前瞻性、经病理证实的验证。

title: A generalist model for diverse text-guided medical image synthesis
zh_title: MediSyn：多样文本引导医学图像生成的通用模型
summary: 提出开放获取的通用文本引导潜在扩散模型MediSyn，仅用公开数据训练，覆盖6个专科10种成像模态。
key_points: 仅使用公开数据训练的通用生成模型，开放获取
覆盖6个医学专科与10种成像模态
生成质量与专用模型相当且计算更高效
reason: 开放权重通用生成模型有方法新意，但缺乏临床结局与外部临床评测
abstract: Deep learning requires extensive data to achieve robust performance. However, data availability is often restricted in medicine due to patient privacy concerns. Synthetic data from medical image generative models present a possible solution to these challenges. Unfortunately, many models are often task-specific or trained on private datasets, limiting scalability and reproducibility. To address this, we introduce MediSyn: an open-access, generalist, text-guided latent diffusion model. MediSyn can generate images across 6 medical specialties and 10 imaging modalities, while being trained exclusively on public data. Our study provides several key contributions using MediSyn. First, we demonstrate that a generalist model can generate images of comparable quality to task-specific models across multiple specialties. Second, we show that this generalist approach is more computationally efficient than a suite of task-specific models. Third, we establish that a generalist model can produce realistic, text-aligned images across visually and medically distinct modalities. Fourth, we empirically demonstrate that these synthetic images are visually distinct from real images used in training. Finally, we show that a generalist model can produce images that improve classifier performance in data-limited settings across multiple specialties. Altogether, our findings highlight the potential of generalist image generative models to accelerate medical algorithmic research and development.
zh_abstract: 深度学习需要大量数据才能实现稳健性能。然而，由于患者隐私问题，医学中的数据可用性通常受到限制。来自医学图像生成模型的合成数据为这些挑战提供了一种可能的解决方案。遗憾的是，许多模型通常针对特定任务或基于私有数据集训练，限制了可扩展性和可重复性。为解决这一问题，我们提出MediSyn：一个开放获取、通用型、文本引导的潜在扩散模型。MediSyn能够在6个医学专科和10种成像模态中生成图像，同时仅使用公开数据训练。我们的研究利用MediSyn提供了若干关键贡献。第一，我们证明通用模型能够在多个专科中生成与任务特定模型质量相当的图像。第二，我们表明这种通用方法比一套任务特定模型计算效率更高。第三，我们确立通用模型能够在视觉和医学上不同的模态中生成逼真且与文本对齐的图像。第四，我们实证表明这些合成图像在视觉上不同于训练中使用的真实图像。最后，我们表明通用模型能够生成在数据有限环境下改善多个专科分类器性能的图像。总之，我们的发现突显了通用图像生成模型加速医学算法研究与开发的潜力。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Early Prediction of Intracranial Hypertension: From Single-Centre Development to Multicentre Validation.
zh_title: XGBoost预测颅内高压：单中心开发到多中心验证
summary: 将乌普萨拉单中心训练的XGBoost模型应用于CENTER-TBI多中心高分辨率ICU队列，评估其预测颅内压阈值突破的性能可迁移性。
key_points: 模型预测短期生理轨迹以预警颅内压升高
训练集来自乌普萨拉单中心既往研究
在多中心CENTER-TBI高分辨率ICU队列外部验证
reason: 具备独立多中心外部验证，属重要档，但为预测性能评估非临床结局试验
abstract: [Neurocritical care] Raised intracranial pressure is one of the most severe secondary insults after traumatic brain injury. Recognising physiological patterns before they progress to dangerous intracranial pressure elevations could enable preventive rather than reactive interventions. In our previous Uppsala single-centre study, an XGBoost machine learning model showed high discriminative performance for prediction of imminent intracranial pressure insults. The model identifies short-term physiological trajectories associated with imminent threshold crossing rather than predicting independent future clinical events. Whether these results are generalisable across centres is unknown. The aim was therefore to evaluate whether the XGBoost model trained on an Uppsala dataset maintains similar performance when applied to a multicentre TBI cohort - The CENTER-TBI High-Resolution ICU cohort. The XGBoost model trained on the Uppsala high frequency traumatic brain injury cohort was externally validated using data from the multicentre CENTER-TBI cohort. Minute-level averages of intracranial pressure and invasive arterial blood pressure were used to predict the onset of an intracranial pressure insult within 30 min on the basis of a 4h historical window. A bidirectional validation design was applied and performance was assessed using multiple metrics. The cohorts comprised 602 patients from Uppsala and 255 patients from the CENTER-TBI database. When trained on the Uppsala cohort and tested on CENTER-TBI, the model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 97.4%, sensitivity of 93.8%, and specificity of 98.6%. Training on CENTER-TBI and testing on the Uppsala dataset yielded an AUROC of 96.1%, sensitivity of 81.2%, and specificity of 98.7%. Balanced accuracy exceeded 88% in both validation directions. The XGBoost model retained high performance under external multicentre validation, indicating that pre-insult physiological patterns preceding increased intracranial pressure are shared across cohorts. Differences in sensitivity between validation directions were observed and may reflect cohort characteristics or dataset size. These findings support the need for local evaluation before clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [神经重症监护] 颅内压升高是创伤性脑损伤后最严重的继发性损害之一。在生理模式进展为危险的颅内压升高之前识别这些模式，可能使干预从反应性转为预防性。在我们先前乌普萨拉（Uppsala）单中心研究中，XGBoost 机器学习模型在预测即将发生的颅内压损害方面表现出高区分性能。该模型识别与即将越过阈值相关的短期生理轨迹，而不是预测独立的未来临床事件。这些结果是否可在各中心间推广尚不清楚。因此，目的是评估在 Uppsala 数据集上训练的 XGBoost 模型应用于多中心 TBI 队列——CENTER-TBI 高分辨率 ICU 队列时是否保持相似性能。在 Uppsala 高频创伤性脑损伤队列上训练的 XGBoost 模型使用多中心 CENTER-TBI 队列的数据进行了外部验证。使用颅内压和侵入性动脉血压的分钟级平均值，基于 4 小时历史窗口预测 30 分钟内颅内压损害的发生。采用双向验证设计，并使用多个指标评估性能。队列包括来自 Uppsala 的 602 例患者和来自 CENTER-TBI 数据库的 255 例患者。当在 Uppsala 队列上训练并在 CENTER-TBI 上测试时，模型达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）97.4%、灵敏度 93.8%、特异度 98.6%。在 CENTER-TBI 上训练并在 Uppsala 数据集上测试得到 AUROC 96.1%、灵敏度 81.2%、特异度 98.7%。两个验证方向的平衡准确率均超过 88%。XGBoost 模型在外部多中心验证下保持高性能，表明颅内压升高之前的损害前生理模式在各队列间共享。观察到两个验证方向之间的灵敏度差异，可能反映队列特征或数据集大小。这些发现支持在临床实施前进行本地评估的必要性。

title: AI-supported first consultation preparation in oncology: a real-world clinical usability study
zh_title: 肿瘤科AI辅助首诊准备的真实世界可用性研究
summary: 前瞻性单组前后对照研究评估LLM生成结构化首诊摘要的工作流表现，9名临床医生完成33次诊疗。
key_points: LLM自动生成结构化首诊摘要
9名医生、33次会诊，单组前后对照
自报工作量NASA-TLX下降28.9%
作者提示可能存在幸存者偏倚
reason: 前瞻性真实世界工作流效果，但样本小、无对照组，属值得一看档
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) may support clinicians by facilitating information management, but their usability in real-world oncology practice remains understudied. This study evaluated the workflow performance of Artificial Intelligence-based First Consultation Preparation (AI-FCP), generating structured summaries from unstructured clinical documentation, co-created with end users. In a prospective single‑group pre‑post design, nine clinicians completed a person-level baseline, followed by 33 consultations with AI-FCP. Case numbers varied by clinic scheduling and enrollment timing, potentially introducing survivorship bias. Usability was evaluated using validated questionnaires and study-specific instruments. Post AI-FCP, overall perceived workload (NASA-TLX) was 28.9% lower than baseline (Hodges-Lehmann estimate difference −12.3; 95% CI –21.7 to –3.3), with self-reported average time savings of 3.26 min (SD = 2.65) per case. Preparation succeeded in 84.9% of consultations; 63.6% of summaries were complete. These exploratory findings suggest clinicians perceived lower workload and reported improved workflow efficiency with AI-FCP. Further research is needed to determine generalizability.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可能通过促进信息管理来支持临床医生，但其在真实世界肿瘤学实践中的可用性仍未得到充分研究。本研究评估了基于人工智能的首次会诊准备（AI-FCP）的工作流程表现，该系统从非结构化临床文档生成结构化摘要，并由最终用户共同创建。在一项前瞻性单组前后设计（pre-post design）中，九名临床医生完成了个人层面的基线评估，随后进行了33次使用AI-FCP的会诊。病例数因门诊排班和入组时间而异，可能引入生存者偏倚。可用性使用经过验证的问卷和研究特定工具进行评估。使用AI-FCP后，总体感知工作量（NASA-TLX）较基线低28.9%（Hodges-Lehmann估计差值 −12.3；95% CI –21.7 至 –3.3），自我报告的每例平均节省时间为3.26分钟（SD = 2.65）。84.9%的会诊准备成功；63.6%的摘要完整。这些探索性发现表明，临床医生认为使用AI-FCP后感知工作量降低，并报告工作流程效率提高。需要进一步研究以确定其可推广性。

title: Large language models for depression assessment from brief daily diaries
zh_title: 大语言模型从每日日记文本评估抑郁程度
summary: 108名参与者完成14–21天视频日记，LLM基于转录文本估计的抑郁分与自评在个体内及跨日均呈相关。
key_points: 108人，45%处于心理治疗状态
reason: 设计规范的前瞻性日记研究，样本百余人且无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Closely tracking changes in depression is important for clinical research and practice. However, intensive longitudinal depression assessment relies on self-report surveys that have major limitations. Scoring depression from natural language with large language models (LLMs) could resolve these shortcomings. This study tested the validity of depression rated by LLMs from daily video diaries. We studied 108 participants selected for mental health treatment status (45% in treatment). Participants completed a clinical interview and 14-21 days of depression surveys and video diaries. Daily depression scores were estimated by LLMs from diary transcripts. LLM ratings converged with self-report depression within-person ( r = .45;95% CrI[.40, .49]) and when averaged across days for an overall depression score ( r = .61;95% CrI[.43,.75]). Averaged LLM ratings correlated with depression symptom severity ascertained by clinical interview ( r = .53;95% CrI[.35, .68]). LLM-rated depression and self-report had similar profiles of associations with daily functioning variables (profile r = .98 within-person; r = .94 between-person). Multivariable regression results showed LLM ratings predicted daily functioning variables (partial $$\beta s$$ β s =|.12 | - | .28 | ) and interview-rated depression (partial $$\beta$$ β =.33;95% CrI[.07, .58]) over and above self-reports, suggesting LLMs capture clinically-relevant information that self-reports miss. Findings establish a strong foundation for a depression assessment approach that addresses shortcomings of self-reports while satisfying the unique demands of intensive longitudinal monitoring.
zh_abstract: 密切追踪抑郁变化对临床研究与实践很重要。然而，密集纵向抑郁评估依赖自我报告调查，而后者存在重大局限。使用大型语言模型（LLMs）从自然语言中为抑郁评分可能解决这些缺点。本研究检验了由LLMs根据每日视频日记评定的抑郁的有效性。我们研究了108名因心理健康治疗状态而选取的参与者（45%正在接受治疗）。参与者完成了临床访谈以及14-21天的抑郁调查和视频日记。每日抑郁评分由LLMs根据日记转录文本估计。LLM评分与自我报告抑郁在个体内收敛（r = .45；95% CrI[.40, .49]），并且在跨天平均得到总体抑郁评分时也收敛（r = .61；95% CrI[.43,.75]）。平均LLM评分与通过临床访谈确定的抑郁症状严重程度相关（r = .53；95% CrI[.35, .68]）。LLM评定的抑郁与自我报告在与日常功能变量的关联模式上相似（模式 r = .98 个体内；r = .94 个体间）。多变量回归结果显示，LLM评分在自我报告之外预测日常功能变量（偏 $$\beta s$$ β s =|.12 | - | .28 | ）以及访谈评定的抑郁（偏 $$\beta$$ β =.33；95% CrI[.07, .58]），表明LLMs捕捉到自我报告遗漏的临床相关信息。这些发现为一种抑郁评估方法奠定了坚实基础，该方法解决自我报告的缺点，同时满足密集纵向监测的独特需求。

abstract: Concerns about generative AI in medical training often focus on eroded reasoning and deskilling. Such competence-based accounts are incomplete. We identify a neglected casualty: critical-feedback tolerance (CFT), the capacity to receive disconfirming evaluative feedback and remain productively engaged. Affirmation-optimized systems may lower CFT undetectably, surfacing only under authentic critique. This conceptual Perspective defines CFT, differentiates it from six established constructs, specifies measurable facets, and states explicit refutation conditions.
zh_abstract: 对医学培训中生成式AI的担忧通常集中在推理能力受侵蚀和技能退化上。此类基于胜任力的论述并不完整。我们识别出一个被忽视的受损对象：批判性反馈耐受性（critical-feedback tolerance, CFT），即接受否定性评价反馈并保持有效参与的能力。以肯定为优化目标的系统可能以不可察觉的方式降低CFT，仅在真实批评下才显现。这篇概念性观点文章定义了CFT，将其与六种既有构念区分开来，明确了可测量的方面，并陈述了明确的证伪条件。

abstract: [Nature computational science] Molecular Hessians, the second derivatives of the potential energy, are fundamental to many workflows in computational chemistry. Usually, accurate Hessians are computationally expensive to calculate and scale poorly with system size, whether computed using quantum chemistry methods or machine learning interatomic potentials. Here we introduce Hessian Interatomic Potentials (HIPs), a deep learning model that directly predicts Hessians without relying on automatic differentiation or finite differences. To do so, we construct SE(3)-equivariant, symmetric Hessians from irreducible representation (irrep) features up to degree l = 2, computed by a graph neural network. HIP Hessians are one to two orders of magnitude faster, more accurate, more memory efficient, easier to train and exhibit favorable scaling with system size. We validate our predictions across a wide range of downstream tasks, demonstrating consistently superior performance in transition state search, geometry optimization, zero-point energy corrections and vibrational analysis. We open source the HIP code and model weights.
zh_abstract: [自然计算科学] 分子 Hessian（势能的二阶导数）是计算化学中许多工作流程的基础。通常，无论是使用量子化学方法还是机器学习原子间势计算，精确 Hessian 的计算成本都很高，并且随系统规模扩展性很差。在此，我们介绍 Hessian 原子间势（Hessian Interatomic Potentials，HIPs），一种直接预测 Hessian 的深度学习模型，不依赖自动微分或有限差分。为此，我们由图神经网络计算得到最高至 l = 2 阶的不可约表示（irrep）特征，并据此构建 SE(3) 等变、对称的 Hessian。HIP Hessian 的速度快一到两个数量级，更准确，内存效率更高，更易于训练，并且随系统规模表现出良好的扩展性。我们在广泛的下游任务中验证了预测，在过渡态搜索、几何优化、零点能校正和振动分析中表现出始终如一的优越性能。我们开源了 HIP 代码和模型权重。

abstract: [European journal of radiology] Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) is a severe obstetric complication. This study evaluated whether retrospective, post-processing deep learning-based super-resolution reconstruction (SR) was associated with improved MRI radiomics performance for predicting PAS and invasive PAS. This retrospective study involved 245 patients who had placental MRI scans at three different institutions. Of these, 158 cases from Institution I for training set and internal validation set, while 34 patients from Institution II and 53 patients from Institution III served as external validation sets. SR using a generative adversarial network (GAN) was applied to generate SR T2WI (SRT2WI). Predictive models for PAS and invasive PAS were developed based on T2WI, SRT2WI, and the SRT2WI-Clinical model. Two radiologists independently diagnosed PAS using T2WI to serve as a reference for evaluating model performance. Model performance was assessed using the area under the curve (AUC), calibration curves, decision curve analysis (DCA), Delong test, and net reclassification improvement (NRI). SHAP values interpreted the models and quantified feature contributions. Across all four cohorts, SRT2WI yielded numerically higher AUCs than T2WI, and SRT2WI-Clinical achieved the highest AUCs. For PAS, SRT2WI-Clinical achieved AUCs of 0.953, 0.887, 0.793, and 0.788 in the training, internal validation, and external validation cohorts 1 and 2, respectively (T2WI: 0.738, 0.697, 0.654, and 0.652; SRT2WI: 0.879, 0.820, 0.696, and 0.768). Corresponding AUCs for invasive PAS were 0.895, 0.875, 0.843, and 0.815 (T2WI: 0.774, 0.699, 0.575, and 0.745; SRT2WI: 0.861, 0.794, 0.729, and 0.808). For PAS, SRT2WI-Clinical significantly outperformed T2WI (P < 0.001) and SRT2WI (P = 0.004) only in training, with no significant validation differences. For invasive PAS, it significantly outperformed T2WI in training, internal validation, and external validation cohort 1 (P = 0.003, 0.021, and 0.019, respectively), but not external validation cohort 2 (P = 0.398); comparisons with SRT2WI were nonsignificant. Calibration showed good agreement, DCA favored SRT2WI-Clinical, and SHAP quantified feature contributions. The combination of SR and radiomics shows promise for improving the prediction of PAS and invasive PAS. Integrating clinical features may further enhance model performance, supporting its potential clinical utility.
zh_abstract: 《European Journal of Radiology》：胎盘植入谱系疾病（Placenta Accreta Spectrum, PAS）是一种严重的产科并发症。本研究评估回顾性、后处理、基于深度学习的超分辨率重建（super-resolution reconstruction, SR）是否与改善MRI放射组学预测PAS和侵袭性PAS的性能相关。这项回顾性研究纳入245例在三家不同机构接受胎盘MRI扫描的患者。其中，来自机构I的158例作为训练集和内部验证集，来自机构II的34例和来自机构III的53例作为外部验证集。应用基于生成对抗网络（generative adversarial network, GAN）的SR生成SR T2WI（SRT2WI）。基于T2WI、SRT2WI和SRT2WI-Clinical模型开发PAS和侵袭性PAS的预测模型。两名放射科医生使用T2WI独立诊断PAS，作为评估模型性能的参考。采用曲线下面积（AUC）、校准曲线、决策曲线分析（DCA）、Delong检验和净重分类改善（NRI）评估模型性能。SHAP值解释模型并量化特征贡献。在所有四个队列中，SRT2WI的AUC数值上高于T2WI，SRT2WI-Clinical达到最高AUC。对于PAS，SRT2WI-Clinical在训练集、内部验证集以及外部验证队列1和2中分别达到AUC 0.953、0.887、0.793和0.788（T2WI：0.738、0.697、0.654和0.652；SRT2WI：0.879、0.820、0.696和0.768）。侵袭性PAS对应的AUC分别为0.895、0.875、0.843和0.815（T2WI：0.774、0.699、0.575和0.745；SRT2WI：0.861、0.794、0.729和0.808）。对于PAS，SRT2WI-Clinical仅在训练集中显著优于T2WI（P < 0.001）和SRT2WI（P = 0.004），在验证集中无显著差异。对于侵袭性PAS，其在训练集、内部验证集和外部验证队列1中显著优于T2WI（P分别为0.003、0.021和0.019），但在外部验证队列2中不显著（P = 0.398）；与SRT2WI的比较无显著差异。校准显示良好一致性，DCA支持SRT2WI-Clinical，SHAP量化了特征贡献。SR与放射组学的结合显示出改善PAS和侵袭性PAS预测的前景。整合临床特征可能进一步增强模型性能，支持其潜在临床效用。

abstract: [Medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being developed for image acquisition, quantitative tissue assessment, diagnosis, and clinical prediction in rotator cuff tears. The breadth of this literature and its methodological limitations have not been integrated across the complete care pathway. We searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library from inception to July 5, 2026 for English-language original studies applying AI to rotator cuff-related reconstruction, segmentation or quantitative imaging, diagnosis or classification, anatomical measurement, or prognosis. Two reviewers screened reports and extracted study, data, model, validation, reference standard, and performance characteristics. Diagnostic accuracy studies were assessed with QUADAS-2 and prediction-model studies with PROBAST. Because clinical tasks, modalities, models, reference standards, and reported metrics were not sufficiently comparable, evidence was synthesized narratively rather than pooled statistically. Sixty-six reports were included: 35 diagnostic accuracy or classification studies, 20 segmentation or quantitative imaging studies, 9 prognosis or outcome prediction studies, 1 Magnetic Resonance Imaging reconstruction or image-optimization study, and 1 exploratory unsupervised-phenotyping study. Applications spanned Magnetic Resonance Imaging, radiography, ultrasound, computed tomography, clinical or multimodal data, motion video, and emerging sensing data. QUADAS-2 classified overall risk-of-bias as high in 27/36 diagnostic studies, unclear in 6/36, and low in 3/36. PROBAST classified all 8/8 completed prediction-model studies as high risk-of-bias; 1 protocol without model results was not rated. Promising internal performance was recurrent, but selection methods, imperfect or incompletely described reference standards, limited external validation, small or selected datasets, and analysis-stage weaknesses constrained clinical inference. AI has proof-of-concept value across rotator cuff imaging and decision support, but the current evidence does not establish routine clinical readiness or replacement of clinician judgment. Prospective multicenter studies, transparent reference standards, independent external validation, calibration and clinical-utility assessment, and standardized task-specific reporting are required.
zh_abstract: [Medicine] 人工智能（AI）正被开发用于肩袖撕裂的图像采集、定量组织评估、诊断和临床预测。该文献的广度及其方法学局限性尚未在完整照护路径中得到整合。我们检索了 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、Scopus 和 Cochrane Library，从建库至 2026 年 7 月 5 日，纳入将 AI 应用于肩袖相关重建、分割或定量成像、诊断或分类、解剖测量或预后的英文原创研究。两名评审员筛选报告并提取研究、数据、模型、验证、参考标准和性能特征。诊断准确性研究用 QUADAS-2 评估，预测模型研究用 PROBAST 评估。由于临床任务、模态、模型、参考标准和报告指标不够可比，证据采用叙述性综合而非统计合并。共纳入 66 份报告：35 项诊断准确性或分类研究、20 项分割或定量成像研究、9 项预后或结局预测研究、1 项磁共振成像重建或图像优化研究，以及 1 项探索性无监督表型分型研究。应用涵盖磁共振成像、X 线摄影、超声、计算机断层扫描、临床或多模态数据、运动视频和新兴传感数据。QUADAS-2 将 27/36 项诊断研究的总体偏倚风险分类为高、6/36 为不清楚、3/36 为低。PROBAST 将所有 8/8 项已完成的预测模型研究分类为高偏倚风险；1 项无模型结果的方案未评级。有希望的内部性能反复出现，但选择方法、不完美或描述不完整的参考标准、有限的外部验证、小型或经选择的数据集以及分析阶段缺陷限制了临床推断。AI 在肩袖成像和决策支持方面具有概念验证价值，但当前证据尚未确立常规临床就绪性或替代临床医生判断。需要前瞻性多中心研究、透明参考标准、独立外部验证、校准和临床效用评估，以及标准化的任务特异性报告。

abstract: Biological research agents often rely on familiar analytical methods, limiting the questions explored in existing data. We introduce BioMINTREL, an AI agent that finds methods from other disciplines and connects them to biological measurements. It can draw on relationships among datasets and complementary ideas from several methods to develop new questions and analyses. We evaluate it on BioMDC-Bench, which assesses 228 possible applications of computational methods to biological tasks. Compared with GPT-5.4 mini and Qwen3.6-35B, BioMINTREL improves F1 agreement with human experts by up to 45.3 percentage points and increases coverage of applications supported by studies published in subsequent years by up to 58.8 percentage points. Four case studies on real data go beyond previous analyses to reveal dose-specific variant effects, constraints on spatial cell communication and routes through perturbation-response states, and identify the sampling needed to test whether rare high-state cells predict later lineage size. These results highlight BioMINTREL's potential to expand questions in existing data and suggest directions for subsequent research.
zh_abstract: 生物学研究智能体常常依赖熟悉的分析方法，限制了在现有数据中所探索的问题。我们提出 BioMINTREL，一种人工智能智能体，它从其他学科寻找方法，并将其与生物学测量相连接。它能够利用数据集之间的关系以及来自若干方法的互补思路，来提出新的问题并开展新的分析。我们在 BioMDC-Bench 上对其进行评估，该基准评估计算方法在生物学任务中的 228 种可能应用。与 GPT-5.4 mini 和 Qwen3.6-35B 相比，BioMINTREL 与人类专家的一致性 F1 最高提升 45.3 个百分点，并且使后续年份发表研究所支持的应用覆盖率最高提升 58.8 个百分点。基于真实数据的四个案例研究超越了以往分析，揭示了剂量特异性变异效应、空间细胞通讯的约束以及扰动-响应状态的路径，并确定了检验罕见高状态细胞是否预测 later lineage size 所需的采样。这些结果凸显了 BioMINTREL 在拓展现有数据中问题方面的潜力，并为后续研究提示了方向。

abstract: [Journal of pharmacy practice] ChatGPT-4o, an advanced Artificial Intelligence based large language model, has demonstrated utility for providing medical information. Data regarding its accuracy and usefulness for hyperlipidemia pharmacotherapy are limited. Additionally, the clinical implications of variability in responses generated from simultaneous identical prompts across multiple sessions remains poorly understood. This research aimed to (1) assess accuracy, (2) evaluate usefulness, and (3) examine perceived impact variability of ChatGPT-4o generated responses to hyperlipidemia-related clinical questions. Five questions addressing hyperlipidemia management and patient counseling were developed. Responses to the questions were collected simultaneously from three independent ChatGPT-4o sessions initiated in separate, newly opened ChatGPT windows. A modified Delphi technique using clinical pharmacy faculty evaluated responses for accuracy, usefulness, and impact variability. Scores were evaluated using a 3-point Likert scale. After initial scoring, responses were collected, collated, and redistributed to faculty for review and optional revision. Final evaluations and consensus were facilitated by a moderator during a virtual panel. Consensus was reached for all responses. Evaluations of response accuracy ranged from poor to good, while usefulness ranged between somewhat useful and very useful. Impact variability ranged from none to high across responses, which faculty concluded could impact patient management. Response variability may have potential clinical implications; however, the present study evaluated expert-perceived potential impact rather than actual patient outcomes. Users should be aware concurrently generated ChatGPT responses can differ in accuracy and usefulness. Clinical judgment and patient-centered multidisciplinary collaboration remain essential. Future directions include using a larger data set to corroborate findings.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Despite advances in computed tomography (CT)-based classification systems for posterior malleolar fractures (PMFs), diagnostic consistency remains limited because these systems are still highly dependent on the observer's experience. This study aimed to develop a deep learning-based automated model capable of classifying PMFs according to the Haraguchi, Mason-Molloy, and Bartoníček-Rammelt clasification systems using CT scans, and to compare the classification performance of different convolutional neural network architectures. Retrospectively collected preoperative CT data from 480 adult patients with PMFs were analyzed. A total of 2398 CT slices were independently classified by three orthopedic surgeons according to the three classification systems, and majority consensus was used as the reference standard. Anonymized DICOM images were evaluated using VGG-16, ResNet-101, and DenseNet-121 architectures. The dataset was divided into 60% training, 20% validation, and 20% testing subsets. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, sensitivity, precision, F1 score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). The VGG-16 and ResNet-101 models demonstrated high classification performance in the Haraguchi and Mason-Molloy systems. In the VGG-16 model, AUC values exceeded 0.90 across most fracture subtypes, reaching particularly high levels in Haraguchi types I-III, Mason-Molloy types IIB and III, and Bartoníček-Rammelt type IV. Similarly, the ResNet-101 model achieved AUC values above 0.90 in most classes, with very high discriminative performance observed in selected subtypes. F1-scores were greater than 0.70 among most fracture categories and exceeded 0.80 in several, indicating strong and consistent classification performance. These findings demonstrate that deep learning-based automated CT classification of PMFs is feasible and diagnostically robust. The proposed framework may improve diagnostic consistency, reduce observer-dependent variability, and support standardized assessment of posterior malleolar fractures in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 《Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine》：尽管基于计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）的后踝骨折（posterior malleolar fractures, PMFs）分类系统已有进展，但诊断一致性仍然有限，因为这些系统仍高度依赖观察者经验。本研究旨在开发一种基于深度学习的自动模型，能够利用CT扫描按照Haraguchi、Mason-Molloy和Bartoníček-Rammelt分类系统对PMFs进行分类，并比较不同卷积神经网络架构的分类性能。回顾性分析480例成年PMFs患者术前CT数据。共2398张CT切片由三名骨科外科医生根据三种分类系统独立分类，并以多数共识作为参考标准。使用VGG-16、ResNet-101和DenseNet-121架构评估匿名DICOM图像。数据集按60%训练、20%验证和20%测试划分。采用准确率、灵敏度、精确率、F1分数和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估模型性能。VGG-16和ResNet-101模型在Haraguchi和Mason-Molloy系统中表现出高分类性能。在VGG-16模型中，大多数骨折亚型的AUC值超过0.90，在Haraguchi I-III型、Mason-Molloy IIB和III型以及Bartoníček-Rammelt IV型中达到特别高的水平。同样，ResNet-101模型在大多数类别中AUC值高于0.90，在选定亚型中观察到非常高的判别性能。大多数骨折类别F1分数大于0.70，并在若干类别中超过0.80，表明分类性能强且一致。这些发现表明，基于深度学习的PMFs自动CT分类可行且诊断稳健。所提出的框架可能提高诊断一致性、减少观察者依赖性变异，并支持临床实践中后踝骨折的标准化评估。

abstract: Machine learning models for molecular discovery often train on bioactivity data from heterogeneous assays, yet assay context is rarely explicitly represented. We investigate whether natural-language assay descriptions provide predictive information beyond molecular and protein representations. We develop ACL-DTI (Assay-aware Contrastive Learning-based Drug Target Interaction) and MAMMAL-AsAP, an assay-context extension of MAMMAL-DTI. Across five triplet-disjoint random splits, assay-aware models achieve competitive or improved performance over assay-agnostic baselines. Among the evaluated models, MAMMAL-AsAP achieves the highest (R^2) of 0.7198 +/- 0.0085. Masking experiments show that ACL-DTI is robust to incomplete assay descriptions, exhibiting the smallest reductions in R^2 among the evaluated models when masking the target name, assay technique, or both: 0.0228 +/- 0.0064, 0.0406 +/- 0.0113, and 0.0620 +/- 0.0190, respectively. These results indicate that assay descriptions contain predictive information not fully captured by molecular structures and protein sequences, and reveal architecture-dependent differences in how this information is exploited.

abstract: [Brain and behavior] Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in dementia research for diagnosis, early detection, prognosis, biomarker characterization, and disease phenotyping. This study aimed to provide a bibliometric and thematic overview of ML applications in dementia, emphasizing biological mechanisms, prediction goals, data modalities, collaborative networks, and emerging computational approaches. A title-field search of the Web of Science Core Collection identified 3,833 records related to ML and dementia. After restricting publications to 2000 onward and excluding non-analytic document types, 3,479 records were included in the bibliometric analysis. A subset of 3,223 original articles was used for thematic analyses. Publication trends, authorship, institutional collaboration, keywords, biomarker themes, ML objectives, data modalities, methods, shared research resources, and large language model (LLM) applications were evaluated. ML-related dementia research increased substantially over time. Diagnostic classification was the predominant ML objective (55.0%), followed by early detection or screening (10.3%), progression or cognitive-decline prediction (6.8%), and biomarker or feature discovery (4.7%). Structural magnetic resonance imaging was the most frequently identified modality (42.6%), followed by clinical or cognitive data (22.4%), positron emission tomography/single photon emission computerized tomography (10.3%), and genetic or genomic data (10.2%). Prominent biological themes included hippocampal measures, amyloid/Aβ, electroencephalogram, tau/p-tau, and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers. Institutional networks showed distinct international collaboration clusters and frequent use of shared infrastructures. Transformer-based and LLM approaches emerged in recent years. ML research in dementia has expanded beyond diagnostic neuroimaging toward multimodal, biomarker, prognostic, and language model applications, although diagnostic classification and structural imaging remain dominant. Emphasis on biological integration, longitudinal validation, and clinical translation are needed.

abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] Breast cancer is biologically heterogeneous, yet conventional clinical decisions rely on static, single-marker proxies (ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67) that capture only a narrow slice of tumor biology. This mini-review argues that AI-driven multi-omics biomarkers offer a valuable shift toward systems-level, model-derived probabilities integrating genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, and imaging information to explain and predict disease behavior more faithfully. We synthesize recent advances across three domains: (i) computational strategies for multi-omics integration, from classical penalized regression and ensemble learning to deep multimodal architectures and foundation-model embeddings; (ii) therapeutically relevant biomarker classes across tissue, liquid biopsy, and imaging modalities; and (iii) emerging pathways for embedding these biomarkers into clinical decision support. We highlight validation, interpretability, and robust handling of missing modalities as prerequisites for clinical trust, and outline how biomarker-driven trials, standardized reporting (e.g., TRIPOD + AI), and privacy-preserving data consortia can move AI-driven multi-omics biomarkers toward clinical and regulatory maturity.

abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] The rapid emergence of global antimicrobial resistance (AMR) has outpaced the development of new antimicrobial agents, necessitating transformative approaches such as AI-driven in-silico drug discovery. Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are promising alternatives due to their broad-spectrum bactericidal activity and limited susceptibility to resistance. However, the transition from bench to bedside remains constrained by certain challenges, such as instability, potency, and cytotoxicity. Here, well-integrated, multi-model AI-driven pipeline strategies for the mining and discovery of novel AMPs are designed to address these concerns through simultaneous multi-purpose optimization. The proposed architectural frameworks combine discriminative AMP classifiers, quantitative potency, and cytotoxicity screening filters to prioritize AMPs with good efficacy and safety profiles. To ensure novelty, the pipeline integrates multi-layer sequential and genomic screening by adopting alignment and profile-based approaches. Structural refinements are achieved through advanced molecular docking (MD) and protein folding approaches, providing mechanistic insights regarding peptide-target interactions. In parallel, enzymatic susceptibility and stability prediction models are incorporated to optimize AMP pharmacokinetic potentials. Notably, the multi-objective pipeline operates within iterative optimization loops; discriminative and generative AI models and sequential redesign strategies refine candidates based on multi-purpose closed feedback loops across stability, novelty, efficacy, and toxicity outcomes. These systematic and integrated approaches overcome key bottlenecks associated with traditional linear drug discovery, potentially reducing late-stage attrition and accelerating the transformation from in-silico predictions to wet-lab validation. Collectively, this review provides reproducible and generalizable blueprints for next-generation antimicrobial agents, demonstrating the computational potentials of AI-driven, multi-model architectural frameworks to tackle the global AMR crisis and favour precision design of AMPs with better therapeutic indices.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] 全球抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）的迅速出现已超过新型抗菌药物的开发速度，因而需要变革性方法，如AI驱动的计算机（in-silico）药物发现。抗菌肽（AMPs）因其广谱杀菌活性和对耐药性的易感性有限而成为有前景的替代方案。然而，从实验室到床旁的转化仍受到某些挑战的限制，如不稳定性、效力和细胞毒性。在此，设计了良好整合的多模型AI驱动流水线策略，用于挖掘和发现新型AMPs，通过同时多目标优化来应对这些问题。所提出的架构框架结合判别性AMP分类器、定量效力以及细胞毒性筛选过滤器，以优先选择具有良好疗效和安全性特征的AMPs。为确保新颖性，该流水线通过采用比对和基于谱的方法整合多层序列和基因组筛选。结构优化通过先进的分子对接（MD）和蛋白质折叠方法实现，提供关于肽-靶标相互作用的机制见解。同时，纳入酶易感性和稳定性预测模型，以优化AMP的药代动力学潜力。值得注意的是，该多目标流水线在迭代优化循环中运行；判别性和生成性AI模型以及序列重设计策略基于跨稳定性、新颖性、效力和毒性结局的多用途闭环反馈来优化候选物。这些系统且整合的方法克服了与传统线性药物发现相关的关键瓶颈，可能减少后期损耗并加速从计算机预测到湿实验验证的转化。总体而言，本综述为下一代抗菌药物提供了可重复和可推广的蓝图，展示了AI驱动的多模型架构框架在应对全球AMR危机以及促进具有更好治疗指数的AMPs精准设计方面的计算潜力。

abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] Automatic sleep stage classification can reduce the burden of manual polysomnographic scoring, but reliable models must account for heterogeneous physiological signals, temporal dependencies, and severe class imbalance. This study presents a dual-stream deep learning framework for five-class sleep staging from 30 s polysomnographic segments using two EEG signals, one EOG signal, and one submental EMG signal. Time-domain features are extracted through one-dimensional convolutions, while complementary time-frequency information is obtained from short-time Fourier transform spectrograms processed by a two-dimensional convolutional branch. The resulting features are fused and analyzed over a five-segment context window using a bidirectional long short-term memory network. Prolonged wake periods are censored only during training to reduce majority-class dominance without altering the evaluation distribution. Subject-wise five-fold cross-validation across 78 subjects yielded a mean accuracy of 91.5%, a balanced accuracy of 78.5%, a macro-F1 score of 77.4%, and a Cohen's kappa of 0.829. Controlled architectural and channel-ablation experiments further quantified the contributions of temporal context, time-frequency processing, wake censoring, and the individual PSG signals. A lightweight time-domain-only variant achieved 88.8% accuracy, 72.7% balanced accuracy, a macro-F1 score of 73.8%, and a Cohen's kappa of 0.779. These findings support the use of multimodal time-frequency fusion for robust automatic sleep staging while highlighting the trade-off between classification performance and model complexity.
